data.body: [P1] Track the selected control for every active publisher. A losing `completeExceptionally(selected)` can claim the winner's callback, then be descheduled while the winning publisher returns and removes its entry. The callback receives `selected`, but this map contains only the loser's newly created `control`, so `wakePublishedContinuationWaiters` does not wake owner futures and an End hook waiting for handler cleanup can deadlock. Store each publisher token's selected control (or reference-count selected controls), and add a race where the winner exits before the loser-drained callback calls `wakePublishedContinuationWaiters`.
